articles.summary: WINCHESTER, Va., September 16, 2026 – It’s long been assumed that American homeowners are opting to stay in their current homes due to high mortgage rates, a tight housing market, and economic uncertainty. But a new national survey conducted by Trex Company suggests homeowners aren't staying put because they're stuck. They're staying on purpose.
articles.title: The Stay Era: Survey Finds 74% of Homeowners Are Choosing to Stay Put Turning Their Current Home into Their Dream Home
